{{Quote|Under the circumstances, it's just as well that you got out when you did. With your obvious disdain for authority, you'd have been quietly eliminated in the Emperor's purge of those officers he hadn't been able to seduce to his side. And then things would have gone quite differently, wouldn't they?|[[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], speaking of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] leaving the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
The '''Emperor's purge''' refers collectively to several related campaigns of repression and persecution in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] which were orchestrated by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], which removed virtually all opposition to his power.

[[File:Jace_Dallin_choke.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Jace Dallin]] is Force-strangled by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].]]

Shortly after assuming [[Politics/Legends|political]] dominion of the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]], Palpatine began to consolidate his power by launching preemptive strikes against numerous enemies, such as political or military personnel who he had been unable to control during his rise to power. Furthermore, any incumbent [[Officer/Legends|officers]] who supposedly held anti-Imperial sentiments were arrested and executed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mulleen]]. His first purge of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] occurred within just two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] into the Empire's existence, and a notable victim of this was the senior officer, [[Jace Dallin]], who was executed for his loyalty to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]; [[Sagoro Autem]] was also targeted for the purge, but the bounty hunter who "captured" him was actually his [[Reymet Autem|son]] in [[Reymet Autem|disguise]] and he was able to escape Coruscant safely. Another good example of this is the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], wherein members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were denounced as [[Treason/Legends|traitors]] to be executed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and his [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].
